messages:
marta-ops: Heads-up: scheduling a terraform apply for release-2026.04 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tonight. Scope: tenant-vpc tfstate split, routing shadow (10% traffic), and service-account key rotation for cross-account roles. Need a canary owner and one-liner for release notes.

lee-infra: Can we do a traffic-shadow instead of direct shift? Shadow for 12 minutes, collect metrics, then proceed to 10% active canary if healthy. Also pin terraform AWS provider to 4.11.5 in the infra modules to avoid drift seen with 4.13.

lee-infra: provider snippet:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 4.11.5"
}
```

connor-sre: +1 shadow approach. Add circuit-breaker: if HTTP 5xx >3% for 3m or error budget burn high, auto-abort. We'll run `scripts/egress-smoke.sh` before traffic shift to validate NAT routes and DNS egress.

anya-release: Release note suggestion: "Tenant tfstate split; routing shadow then 10% canary; SA key rotation; aws provider pinned (4.11.x)." I'll paste into the draft.

marta-ops: Plan commands for the run:
```bash
# dry-run
terraform plan -var 'shadow=true' -var 'canary_pct=10' -out release-2026-04.plan
# apply via deploybot at window start
/deploybot apply 6105001112 --workspaces=tenant-vpc,routing --tag release-2026-04-shadow
```

deploybot: deploybot: Preflight: state snapshot verified, backend lock ready. Queued workspaces: tenant-vpc, routing. ETA apply start: 2026-04-02T02:05:00Z. To cancel before start: `/deploybot cancel 6105001112`. Runbook: `/deploybot status 6105001112` shows live status and run-id for rollbacks.

lee-infra: Backup note: snapshot will be stored at `s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/6105001112.tar.gz`. If we need to revert, we restore that snapshot and run the pinned module restore tag `infra-release-2026-04-rollback`.

connor-sre: Rollback command (if circuit-breaker trips): `/deploybot rollback 6105001112 --reason "canary error-rate" --restore-tag infra-release-2026-04-rollback`

marta-ops: Assigning canary owner: @lee-infra for the shadow phase and @connor-sre for the active canary shift. Please ack.

lee-infra: acked. I'll upload `release-2026-04.plan` to the thread after dry-run (10-15m).

anya-release: Quick ask: include the one-liner and a short blurb in the release notes about SA rotation: who to contact if tokens fail (connor-sre).

connor-sre: Added a smoke-check helper in PR: `infra/tools/egress-smoke.sh` and `infra/tools/sa-validate.py` to confirm rotated SA keys can assume roles. Tagging @marta-ops for verification.

deploybot: Action: locks will be taken 60s before apply start. Post-apply health checks: routing probe, 3m latency baseline, and egress check. Health policy: fail-open disabled. If any health check fails, system will auto-trigger rollback.

marta-ops: Final: start 02:05 UTC, shadow 12m, observe 10m, then 10% active canary for 10m; progressive shift only on green metrics. If rollback: restore from s3 snapshot and revert modules to tag `infra-release-2026-04-rollback`. Will post live updates here during the window. :white_check_mark:
